title: Code of practice for treatment of rock foundations, core and abutment, contacts with rock, for embankment dams
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11973) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Code of practice for treatment of rock foundations, core and abutment, contacts with rock, for embankment dams.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Recommendations for grouting of pervious soils
Code of practice for design, construction and maintenance of relief wells
Pressure grouting of rock foundations in river valley projects - Recommendations
Guidelines for the Design of Grout Curtains for Earth and Rock Fill Dams, Masonry Dams and Concrete Gravity Dams

clause_3_terminology: Code of practice for treatment of rock foundations

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
